summary: Dual-mode per-frame updater over an element array (base this+0x10, stride 120 bytes, count this+0xC). When flags bit 0 (this+0x0) is set and the countdown counter this+0x8 is above 0, the counter is decremented and every element gets its +68 dword reset to -1082130432 (a -1.0f float) followed by sub_4A2840(element, 0.0). When flags bit 1 (this+0x0) is set, a delta a2 - this[1] is computed and sub_4A2840(element, delta) runs on every element. The two modes are independent and can both run in one tick.

local_names.a2: current value used to derive the per-element delta against this[1]
local_names.v3: countdown counter value read at this+0x8 before decrement
local_names.v4/v6: iteration counters for the two element loops
local_names.v5/v7: byte offsets into the element array (stride 120)
local_names.v8: delta = a2 - this[1] used by mode 2

operations.description: Mode-1 enable: flags byte at this+0x0 has bit 0 set.
Countdown gate: the counter at this+0x8 must be greater than 0 for mode 1 to act.
Decrement the countdown counter at this+0x8.
Element-count gate: the count at this+0xC must be greater than 0 before either loop runs.
Walk the element array at base this+0x10, 120 bytes per element, once per element in this+0xC.
Write the dword -1082130432 (a -1.0f bit pattern) to each element's +68 slot.
Mode-2 enable: flags byte at this+0x0 has bit 1 set.
Compute the per-element delta v8 = a2 - this[1] (reference value at this+0x4).
Element-count gate for mode 2: the count at this+0xC must be greater than 0.
Walk the element array at base this+0x10, 120 bytes per element, once per element in this+0xC.
Update each element with sub_4A2840(element, delta).
